citations.claim: DTV embassy application fee is 10,000 THB, non-refundable regardless of outcome
Application must be submitted from outside Thailand
Processing time varies by embassy: roughly 3-7 days at faster posts (Vientiane, Kuala Lumpur), 4-6 weeks at busier posts (London, Washington DC, Tokyo)
thaievisa.go.th is the only official DTV e-Visa application system
citations.source: Official Website of Thailand Electronic Visa

unverified.claim: DTV visa agent fees typically run 30,000 to 80,000 THB
unverified.reason: Sourced from widely-discussed online applicant communities (Reddit, per docs/reddit-insights/price-dtv-thailand-2026-06-08.md); no single authoritative published source states this range.
